input.quote: Customer shall pay the Fees stated in each Order Form. Fees are fixed during the initial term unless an Order Form expressly provides a usage-based unit price. Vendor may not impose a platform, support, administration, minimum-use, or similar charge that the Order Form does not identify.
input.rationale: Searches for "liquidated", "penalty", "termination fee", "convenience", "accelerat", and "minimum" return no provision requiring Customer to pay liquidated damages, a penalty, an early-termination fee, or accelerated/minimum fees on termination. Section 7.1 limits Customer's payment obligation to Order Form Fees and bars unidentified minimum-use or similar charges; Section 27.3 expressly lets Customer terminate "without penalty"; Section 24.4 bars Vendor from accelerating Fees on a Customer change of control. The only Customer-payable exposures are the Section 2.1 take-or-pay volume commitment (a minimum-commitment issue addressed under the MINCOMMIT rule, not a liquidated-damages or penalty mechanic) and the Section 22.2 audit-shortfall cost shift (actual amounts owed, not a stipulated penalty). Nothing in the document imposes liquidated damages on Customer, so the preferred position is met by silence and no redline is warranted.
